claim: A security incident affected approximately $6.3 billion at Binance.
caption:
DEVELOPING — 30 October 2026: Binance reports a security incident affecting approximately $6.3 billion. The exchange says around $3 billion has been frozen and it will cover losses. Withdrawals were temporarily suspended; the investigation is ongoing. Frozen does not mean recovered, and the compensation statement is Binance’s commitment, not an independent guarantee.
Sources: https://www.binance.com/en/support/announcement/detail/c5a8729a97ac486d963784d96c5642d7
https://www.trmlabs.com/resources/blog/north-korea-steals-usd-6-36-billion-from-binance-in-the-largest-hack-in-history
AI illustration — not actual footage. AI-assisted research and design.
Checked 30 October 2026; independent automated evidence and visual review.
